result.description: Mirevo Lunara T2 is a tabletop aroma diffuser for home and studio use, designed to disperse essential-oil mist quietly in small rooms, meditation spaces, and office desks. It features a 220 mL water reservoir, ultrasonic vaporization, two mist modes, automatic shutoff, and a soft amber night light. The unit uses USB-C power and a removable polymer tank for easy cleaning. Not intended for data storage or gaming; this is a wellness appliance in the personal-care category.
result.title: Lunara T2 Compact Aroma Diffuser
